title: CONNECT-UDP Socket Lifecycle Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 CONNECT-UDP UDP socket lifecycle, source validation, and outbound forwarding policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdpSocketLifecyclePolicy` validates packet source address and port on non-connected sockets, classifies unmatched packets for discard, keeps sockets tied to open request streams, closes request streams when sockets fail or close, models inactivity-based socket closure with a two-minute recommendation floor, avoids IP fragmentation, drops oversized HTTP Datagrams, and exposes IPv4 DF intent when supported.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is a deterministic policy surface. It does not own the operating-system socket or consume packets directly.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Connected sockets bypass source comparison because the operating system performs endpoint filtering.
The inactivity timeout recommendation is represented as a minimum duration.
IPv4 DF policy is gated by both destination address family and socket support.
risks: Adapter code still needs to map these decisions to real socket options and stream-close operations.
End-to-end packet I/O remains covered by later ProtocolLab proof.
